data_rule: Only the 12 development participants of outer fold 0. Fitting uses each inner fold's training participants up to the protocol fit cutoff (2020-01-01T00:00Z); the outer test participants are never read for training, tuning or calibration.

history_accessor.rule: rows of the protocol feature policy (and the steps policy below) whose start is at or after cutoff minus context and that are available_by the cutoff; the last 48 h must equal the harness history exactly

chronos_zero_shot.steps_covariate_role: past-only covariate; never a future covariate

chronos_finetune.dtype: float32 (bf16 and tf32 disabled; #1 did not certify BF16 on the GB10)
chronos_finetune.context_hours: the zero-shot context with the lowest pooled inner-validation MAE
chronos_finetune.early_stopping: keep the checkpoint with the lowest loss on the training participants' last 168 h before the fit cutoff (temporal holdout); training windows end before that holdout

ridge_head.target: the next 24 hourly values minus the context mean (personal) or minus the training population mean (population)
ridge_head.alpha_selection: lowest MAE on the training participants' windows whose targets fall in the last 168 h before the fit cutoff, then refit on all training windows
ridge_head.embedding_features: mean over all Chronos-2 encoder tokens of the context, plus the context location and scale
ridge_head.population_features: target hour-of-day (sin/cos) and lead only; the ablation removes every personal-history feature

intervals_for_point_candidates: each point model's own meta out-of-fold residuals within the inner fold's training participants: median + the 0.1/0.9 quantiles of truth minus median (lower offset capped at 0, upper at least 0), clipped to metric bounds; coverage is measured only on the inner fold's untouched validation participants

excluded_members.chronos-2-finetuned: a fine-tune per meta-fold would add 24 fine-tunes (~8 GPU hours); it stays a standalone candidate

ensembles.member_quantiles: a member's native deciles when it has them (Chronos-2 variants); point members contribute their median at every level
ensembles.equal_weight: mean of present members' value per decile
ensembles.stacked: per decile, nonnegative weights summing to 1 minimizing pinball loss (linear programme, HiGHS) over the inner fold's meta out-of-fold points where every member predicted and the label is eligible
ensembles.abstaining_members: weights renormalized over the members present at a point; no member present means abstain
ensembles.quantile_crossing: the combined deciles are sorted (monotone rearrangement) before the median and 0.1/0.9 interval are read
ensembles.support_reporting: per fold: meta points available, labelled, complete across members (used to fit), and each member's meta abstentions

serving_refit: the selected candidate is refit on all 12 development participants of outer fold 0 with the same fit cutoff; residual-based intervals use all three folds' validation residuals

meta_plan.manifests: train = inner-fold training participants minus the held meta group; validation = the held group; test = outer test plus the inner fold's validation participants (sealed); protocol lookback/horizon/stride/min history/embargo

budgets.latency: p95 of a single request on the model's serving hardware <= 1.0 s; an ensemble's latency is the sum of its members' p95
budgets.memory: peak RSS of a dedicated fit+predict process (CPU models) or the GX10 inference process plus its CUDA-allocated peak (GPU models), each <= 4 GiB; an ensemble takes its largest member; traced Python allocations are reported, never gated
budgets.coverage_denominator: the candidate's scored, label-eligible validation targets, participant-weighted; abstentions excluded and gated separately

amendment_1.post_selection_calibration: after selection only, a point model's served interval may be recalibrated on the three folds' inner-validation residuals; recorded with its own provenance and never reported as independently calibrated coverage; the outer test stays sealed
